default.notes: Apply for a visitor visa at the nearest Taipei Economic and Cultural Office (Taiwan's de facto embassies) — check which office covers your country, as Taiwan has no consular presence in some.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 90 days with a confirmed onward or return ticket; the visa-exempt stay cannot normally be extended.
Visa-free for up to 30 days with a confirmed onward or return ticket.
Visa-free for up to 14 days under a trial programme that has been repeatedly extended — confirm it is still in force before travel.

Travellers who hold a valid (or recently expired) visa or residence permit from designated countries can use the free online travel authorisation for a 14-day stay; otherwise a visitor visa is required.
Eligible for the Taiwan eVisa — apply online before travel.
Hong Kong and Macao permanent residents apply online for a free entry permit rather than a visa; those not eligible online apply through the National Immigration Agency.

CN.notes: Mainland Chinese citizens need entry permits issued by both sides rather than a visa; individual tourist travel has been suspended since 2019, and only limited categories such as business, family visits and approved group programmes are processed.

TW.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Taiwanese citizens.
